_doc: Canonical Ozzu infra registry. Edit THIS file when topology changes — scripts/lib/infra.sh and backend/bridge/lib/devices.js consume it. Human-prose context (history, decisions, lessons) lives in ~/.claude/projects/-home-gcp-ozzu/memory/infra_registry.md.
_secrets_doc: Secret values live in ~/.ozzu-secrets (gitignored; see infra/secrets.example for template). This file references them by env-var name only via *_secret_var fields.
